webRule.authority: Q24 following source review; scoped to the listed mounted instances on eligible native heroes
webRule.contribution: Sum one workbook-selected STR/AGI/INT vector per eligible equipped instance. Repeated aliases survive as ordered source occurrences; use the selected vector exactly once. No contribution from recipe books.
webRule.derived: Apply effective stat changes once; +15 max life/+0.1 life regen per STR, +12 max mana/+0.03 mana regen per INT, +0.002 attack speed and zero armor per AGI. Set current by actual max delta for stat changes. Effective primary*1.4 feeds the weapon base and its percent calculation; direct script max-resource and weapon modifiers stay separate.
webRule.ordering: Attach before PICKUP and detach before DROP, then run original scripts. Do not rerun effects after a swap, failed delivery, or load. Restore saved resources/offsets and reconstruct mounted vectors directly.
webRule.scope: Static AIab contribution only. Keep ordinary carrier eligibility, death inventory disposition, full summon/bear/illusion inheritance and other equipment capabilities under their own audits.
